item.title: HS SWIMMING: Area’s best ready to race at annual Classic Gold Relay Invitational
item.description: Lackawanna County’s best swimmers will form teams for championship-level relays in one of the premier postseason events. Scranton Prep hosts the 24th annual Classic Gold Relay Invitational on Sunday at noon at the University of Scranton. Teams participating include Scranton Prep, Abington Heights, Delaware Valley, Holy Cross, Lake-Lehman and Tunkhannock. Featured races include the 200-yard free, 400 medley, 200 backstroke relay, 800 free relay, 200 breaststroke relay, 400 individual medley relay

item.title: People on the Move, February 1, 2026
item.description: Camelback Resort As part of its continued focus on enhancing guest experiences, the year-round recreational destination in the Pocono Mountains has appointed Christopher Baulo as its new director of food and beverage and Kavon William Langley as executive chef. In his new role, Baulo will oversee the resort’s expansive culinary operations, which include 25 dining outlets ranging from food trucks and all-day casual venues to upscale dining concepts. Langley will lead day-to-day kitchen operations

item.title: Johnson College receives $75,000 to expand RISE program
item.description: Johnson College received $75,000 in Lackawanna County job-creation funding from the Department of Planning and Economic Development to expand the transformative RISE (Readiness in Skilled Employment) program. From left: Karen Baker, senior director of grants and foundation relations, Johnson College; Katie Pittelli, Ed.D., president and CEO, Johnson College; Lackawanna County Commissioner Bill Gaughan; and Dr. Kellyn Williams, Ph.D., associate vice president of special programs, Johnson College.

item.title: AHL: Depth, development are pillars to Penguins’ success

item.title: Dice and decks turn local hobby shops into community hubs
item.description: As digital entertainment, social media and artificial intelligence isolate people from each other, in-person tabletop and trading card games are bringing them together.

item.title: Old Forge borehole’s mine water eyed for reclamation, hydroelectricity
item.description: A mine-water reclamation plan has goals of diverting and purifying polluted borehole water, returning clean water to the river and, in the process, also generating hydroelectric power.
